results.name: A1 plain "Error:" at any level is an error
A2 any "[…错误]" category anywhere is an error (not only line start)
A3 console.error level with unrecognised text → error "unrecognised-error-level"
A4 WeappLog level tags: [error] [console.error] [warn] [warning] [log]; timestamps stripped
A5 other JS error classes + Uncaught; benign info stays info
B1 only the EXACT normalised canary is exempt (boot / late / whitespace-normalised)
B2 canary + any other text is NOT exempt; the rest is evaluated
B3 foreign-token canary → canary-foreign; canary at log/warn level is not a canary
D1 exact notice (whole normalised payload) → known-notice, at error or unknown level
D2 notice with ANY other text (before/after, other error first) → error, never allowlisted
D3 no suffix/end-of-line extraction API remains
audit uses no STRONG pattern gate and no CANARY_RE
